name: layout-grid
title: Layout Grid
description: A four-photo mosaic of travel images. Clicking one lifts it into the middle of the grid, dims the rest and slides a white title and caption up over the picture; clicking the dark area puts it back.
use: An image-led section where visitors should open a single photo without leaving the page.
avoid: Keyboard or screen-reader use: the tiles are clickable divs with no tab stop or roles.
a11y: Cards are clickable divs with no keyboard access or roles, and the alt text is just the word thumbnail. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A four-photo mosaic on black: a wide close-up of hands fanning banknotes, a dark contour swirl, a plant against a tiled wall and a wide sea cliff. Cards sit close together with small gaps, and the whole grid dims when one is open.
behaves: Clicking a photo lifts it into the centre of the grid, where it enlarges while a black veil fades behind it and its title and copy slide up from the bottom. Clicking the dark area returns it.
customise: Pass a cards array of id, thumbnail, content and a className for the grid span; the expanded size, veil darkness and motion are fixed.
weight: moderate: Four large photos with shared layout animations on open and close.
